detail: EDGAR submissions for CIK 0001943896 checked first and are definitive for all 8-K-triggering event types (nothing filed since 2026-09-26 but a routine Form 4/144 on 2026-09-25) — this failure is only about the supplementary own-news check (e.g. a third-party rating action), which could not be completed. www.rubrik.com/sitemap.xml returned HTTP 403 (Access Denied, Akamai edge); www.rubrik.com/company/newsroom, /company/newsroom/feed, /company/newsroom/rss.xml, and /feed all returned HTTP 403 the same way; ir.rubrik.com returned a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge page; businesswire.com's own search was blocked with HTTP 403; prnewswire.com/news/rubrik/ loaded but returned 'No results'; globenewswire.com's search path for Rubrik returned a 404.
